title: Pest control Document Reviewer
oneLiner: Document review handled by a long-context reviewer, with a human signing rather than writing. Aimed at pest control owner-operators, finding what the inspector would find, first.
problem: Pest control teams lose a 900-page document read by someone billing $300 an hour. Every pest control team solves this the same way: someone stays late. Most operators assume this is simply the cost of doing business.
solution: A long-context reviewer that handles document review end to end and hands a human the exceptions rather than the queue. Revenue is flat saas, which suits a buyer who wants the cost to track the value rather than the seat count.
scoreRationale: Carried by timing (92), held back by money (52).

build.hardestPart: The incumbent is a person, and displacing a person is a change-management problem.

whyNow: Million-token context windows made whole-document reasoning possible in one pass. Pest control is growing at roughly 13% a year, and this job has not been re-tooled since it was designed around paper.
